title: Chapter 66
text:
After the materials and parts were in place, Han Xiao praised Feng Jun as usual, saying things like, "Little Comrade Feng Jun is very good at his job, and the Party is very proud of him." After receiving more than ten eye rolls, Han Xiaoxin was satisfied and went into seclusion.

He took out the two Berserk Eagles and started to modify them. [Basic Weaponry] and [Basic Mechanical Engineering] both increased by a few levels, and the effect was better than before. He also changed some parts and replaced them with better materials.

Now that we're rich, the days of being poor are gone, and we can't go back. Let's just forget about the hard times and think about the sweet times.

Han Xiao was very familiar with the modification of basic firearms, and it did not take long for him to complete the modification.

Berserk Eagle (Enhanced)

Quality: Green

Basic Stats: Attack 74-87, Fire Rate 1.5/s, Magazine Capacity 8, Effective Range 50 meters (Accuracy will be lost after exceeding 50 meters), Energy Output Level 45

Prerequisite: Lv.3 Precision Shooting

Bonus Stats: + 2 DEX

Length: 0.21m

Weight: 4.2lb

Bonus Ability: Recoil – Strong recoil. Accuracy will be lost if STR is lower than 30.

Bonus Ability: Powerful Kinetic Energy – Within the range, there is a 10% chance of dealing 15 additional damage.

Bonus Ability: Dual Shot – This firearm has been modified to be able to fire two bullets simultaneously. When using this effect, STR will be reduced by 20%.

Remark: Do you think I won't recognize you if you change 'Sha' to 'Berserk'?

With Han Xiao's current ability, he had a 30% to 40% chance of upgrading normal equipment to green grade. Both guns were green grade, but following that came the equipment requirements. Han Xiao realized that his [Precision Shooting] was only at level one. Although it did not hinder him from using two guns, the power of the two guns would be greatly reduced, and he would not be able to enjoy the buffs of various skills.

Shaking his head helplessly, Han Xiao used his experience to upgrade [Precision Shooting] to Lv.3 and added 3% to [Shooting Correction] and 4% to [Critical Hit Rate].

[Basic Shooting] has exceeded Lv.8, [Precision Shooting] has reached Lv.3. Please choose one of the following three advanced skills: [Snipe], [Close Range Gunfighting], or [Strafing].

Han Xiao raised his eyebrows and fell into a dilemma. This was the first time he had hesitated to choose a skill.

Shooting was the core skill of a Cannon Gunner, and it was also very important for a Mechanic. These three paths clearly indicated different combat styles: Sniper, Melee Gunner, and Firepower.

The Berserk Eagle was a close-range gun. Logically speaking, choosing close-range gunfighting would be the most cost-effective. However, Han Xiao still had to consider his future potential. In the future, long-range combat would be the strength of a Mechanic. On the other hand, the thrilling gunfighting technique was the least useful. Firepower was more suitable for attacking and required teammates to provide support. Sniping was more suitable for solo operations.

Han Xiao scratched his head and thought to himself, Sooner or later, I'll have to act alone. The farther the distance, the safer I'll be. Players can choose to use gunfighting and strafing, but for me, sniping is the most suitable!

In Han Xiao's previous life, gunfighting was very popular. It was elegant and dazzling. A few Cannon Gunner professional players in the previous seasons would also choose gunfighting to show off their skills. It looked so cool when they fought.

However, Han Xiao was not interested in this. He was a pragmatist. Whether it was a black cat or a white cat, as long as it could act cute, it was a good cat. What was the use of looking cool when fighting? He did not need fans to cheer him on. What was the most suitable for him was the best.

With that in mind, Han Technician no longer hesitated. He chose Sniping and invested in the future.

Advanced skill obtained: Sniping Lv.1: Fixed 4% Critical Point Accuracy, increased 5% Range!

Done!

Han Xiao nodded with satisfaction and moved on to the next task.

The Cloud Swallow Glider was manufactured, and he received 1,500 EXP. Han Xiao added the folding technology from the Retractable Knife to it. This was the benefit of being able to truly understand the knowledge. He could apply the principles of other blueprints to other suitable machines.

Normally, the Cloud Swallow Glider could be carried on his back like a parachute. Once it was activated, the two 1.2-meter-long glider wings would extend and allow him to glide in the air. It was much better than the Batsuit.

Next, he needed to enhance his close combat ability. The mechanical arm and the mechanical leg were a complete set. They were both blueprints that could be developed from the same knowledge combination. In the future, they could form the most basic exoskeleton power armor. However, Han Xiao did not plan to make the mechanical leg. His current technology was not perfect yet. Even if he made the mechanical leg, it could only be used for long-distance travel. It could not be used for dodging in a small area. However, Han Xiao needed dodging ability the most, so he did not want to waste his EXP.

Han Xiao decided to modify the mechanical arm first. The weight and size could be reduced. Reducing the size meant reducing the power. Therefore, Han Xiao planned to use another small device to enhance the power of the mechanical arm.

Do you want to proceed with knowledge fusion (Lv.3 Basic Weaponry + Lv.2 Basic Assembly + Lv.2 Basic Mechanics)? This fusion will cost you 15000 EXP.

Fusion successful. Congratulations on developing [Air Pressure Oscillator]!

"Yo, I succeeded on the first try."

Han Xiao was slightly happy. There were many blueprints for this combination, and he had developed the one he needed on the first try. His luck was not bad, and he saved a lot of EXP.

The Air Pressure Oscillator's core principle was somewhat similar to an air gun, but it compressed air into vibrational force and released a direct hit to the inside of the object. It could ignore the defense of normal armor, but it was much less effective against anti-seismic objects.

Han Xiao spent most of the day modifying the Lightweight Mechanical Arm. He reduced the size of the mechanical arm, increased the length, and installed a platinum alloy outer armor to cover the internal components, greatly increasing the durability.

The new mechanical arm looked a lot better overall. Its appearance was a shiny silver metal arm.

Han Xiao created the Air Pressure Oscillator and installed it in the palm of the mechanical arm. He tested it a little, and it worked well.

Lightweight Mechanical Arm (Left) – Oscillator Modified

Grade: White

Basic Attributes: Attack 30 – 48, Defense 10 – 13, Power Level 33, Durability 470/470

Equipment Requirement: 24 STR

Bonus Attribute: -2 ATK SPD

Length: 0.87 meters (Left palm to shoulder)

Weight: 11.4 pounds

Additional Effect: + 7 STR Judgement

Additional Ability: Oscillation – Equipped with a Air Pressure Oscillator that can release an oscillation attack on the target through contact, dealing 23 – 45 damage (Ignores armor other than anti-seismic). Automatically collects air to recharge. Can be used once every 15 seconds.

Additional Ability: Impact Resistance – External armor is made of platinum alloy, which increases durability and does not wear out easily.

Note: It's a normal style modification.

Although it was only White grade, because Han Xiao had installed the accessories, there were three additional effects.

These few equipment modifications were considered normal, but the equipment that Han Xiao was going to create next could be said to be equipment that was truly exclusive to Mechanics!

Han Xiao took a deep breath and thought to himself, Amitabha, Lord Taishang has given the order. God bless me, I have to fuse that blueprint in one go. I don't want to do it a second time. It's really a waste of experience …

Do you want to proceed with Knowledge Fusion (Lv.2 Advanced Material Synthesis + Lv.2 Basic Electromagnetic Theory + Lv.2 Basic Assembly)? This fusion will cost 70,000 EXP!
